meta.title: Why I Didn't Move to NYC (Brooklyn).
meta.description:
What happened Mikey! Why aren't you there Mikey! 

Subscribe! Follow me on instagram! (@8thWeekday)

BROOKLYN BABY! I'm moving to Brooklyn in New York City! The NYC! In the Crown Heights if any of you are wondering. In this video I chat about why I didn't move there right away, apartment costs, decorating my apartment, and of course LL Bean Slippers (wicked good slippers ofc). Also I know I'm showing Manhattan in the thumbnail but I just don't think I'm an Upper West Side type person but maybe I'm wrong. Who knows. Half of this stuff I just make up.
